slides.text: From 780K to 3.5M Subs via Dark History
slides.speech: In nine months of 2020, one creator surged from 780,000 to 3.5 million subscribers by pioneering true crime makeup. Before launching her viral series, Bailey Sarian worked at IPSY, Sephora, and Urban Decay. Her fascination with dark history started in childhood when her mother, a 911 dispatcher, brought her to work. Despite a childhood speech impediment affecting the letter R and entering therapy at age eighteen, she expanded into her hit podcast Dark History, starting with the DuPont chemical scandal. To survive researching dark crimes daily, she limits her social media screen time to just 45 minutes per day.
